sample_unit: responses (150 human specialist and 150 ChatGPT-4o answers to endometriosis forum questions)

links.outcome: Blinded expert rating of LLM vs human specialist answers for incorrect information, harm, consensus alignment, patient suitability
links.effect: Most responses accurate (84.8%), harmless (87.2%), patient-suitable (73.8%); no significant differences between AI and human for incorrect information (p=0.308), harm likelihood (p=0.944), harm extent (p=0.892), consensus alignment (p=0.235), suitability (p=0.544).
links.quote: There were no significant differences regarding incorrect information (p = 0.308), harm likelihood (p = 0.944), harm extent (p = 0.892), medical consensus alignment (p = 0.235), or suitability for patients (p = 0.544).

screen.reason: The study is an offline comparative evaluation benchmarking LLM responses (GPT-4o) against human specialist answers to patient forum questions regarding endometriosis.
